d1.text:
Open decisions

None. All seven groups approved.

Decided: admin roles = Admin + Editor · capsules keep optional Decrees (above Prayer in editor and page; hidden on the page when empty) · group 7 approved (motion spec; built with CSS + component and animation libraries) · no event types for now (easy to add later) · plain full page loads, view transitions later · group 6 approved (incl. unsaved-changes prompt) · group 5 approved · group 4 approved (About = Who We Are + Team and Arms) · group 3 approved · Capstone Capsules dropdown · homepage + Today’s Capsule approved · references = Desiring God + Our Daily Bread · Gallery out of scope · Night Water dark palette · lockup B · footer F1 · header H1 · menu: Home, About, Capstone Capsules, Blog, Events, Books, Partner With Us, Contact · Events is a list page · no Gallery in menu

h1.text:
Homepage sections are reorderable in the admin section builder:
1 Today’s Capsule (fixed first)
2 Current series
3 Explore past series
4 From the blog
5 Events + Books

Each can be hidden or moved.

t3.text: Group 3 · Capsule page, archive and search

g3n.text:
Notes
• Capsule page = any past capsule; Today’s Capsule is the same template plus the date arrows.
• “On this day in past years” uses the 14-year archive.
• Search runs on Pagefind: instant, no server. Filters: type, year, series.
• Counts (3,842 capsules, 186 series) are illustrative.

t4.text: Group 4 · About, Books, Partnership, Contact, Events

g4n.text:
Needed from you for group 4
• Bank name and account number (Partnership only)
• Bios and roles for the other three team members, and portraits
• Contact email, phone and address
• Book covers and how readers get copies
Wording elsewhere comes from the current site.

t5.text: Group 5 · Blog post, event detail, email signup, 404

g5n.text:
Notes for group 5
• Event detail page added: past events in the list open it
• Signup shows all four states: check inbox, confirmed, link expired, unsubscribed
• Blog body text is placeholder; the editor supports headings, scripture quotes, lists and images

t6.text: Group 6 · Admin: login, dashboard, capsule editor, calendar, homepage sections, subscribers, events

g6n.text:
Notes for group 6
• The admin uses the same palette and fonts, with a darker deep-water side menu so it never looks like the public site
• Blog and Settings are in the menu but not drawn: Blog reuses the capsule editor; Settings holds bank details, contact details and team / arms lists
• Two roles: Admin (everything, incl. homepage layout, settings and users) and Editor (writes and publishes capsules, blog posts and events; no layout or settings)
• Capsules publish at midnight WAT by default; email goes out when it publishes
• Closing the events panel (× or Cancel) with unsaved edits asks first: Save draft, Keep editing or Discard. Clicking outside or pressing Esc doesn't close it. Same rule for every admin editor.

g7n.text:
Decided: page changes

Plain full page loads for the public site (Astro MPA). No view transitions for now; the page-change demo is kept as “later”.

How it gets built
The timings above are the spec, not hand-written animation. Simple hovers and fades use CSS transitions with the duration and easing tokens. Menus, the phone menu, dialogs and toasts come animated from the UI component library, tuned to these tokens. A small animation library (e.g. Motion) is used only where CSS isn't enough. All of it respects reduced motion.
